question: Is the symbol-by-symbol shipped-tag audit and Zalo delivery evidence sufficient to approve these public SDK removals on the rebased head?
rationale: Public Plugin SDK deletion is compatibility-sensitive, and the available review evidence does not independently establish that every removed export was absent from all shipped packages or show the changed Zalo failure path in a real setup.

options.title: Require refreshed compatibility and live proof
options.body: Rebase the branch, document shipped-package checks for each removed symbol, and add redacted real Zalo success/failure evidence before approval.

options.title: Defer removals to the SDK major
options.body: Land only the bundled caller migration and documentation now, preserving the deprecated exports until the next planned Plugin SDK major.

recommendation.title: Require refreshed compatibility and live proof
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, document shipped-package checks for each removed symbol, and add redacted real Zalo success/failure evidence before approval.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked cleanup issue, protected routing label, and branch commits make this person the clearest available owner of the compatibility proof decision.
